definitions.explanation: The sensation perceived by the tongue when eating or drinking something. Can refer to sweet, salty, sour, bitter, or umami flavors.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{食|た}べ{物|もの}→食べ物：02890_tabemono⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{味|あじ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。

examples.notes: Common way to ask about food

examples.japanese: ⟦もう→もう：00602_mou⟧⟦{少|すこ}し→少し：00596_sukoshi⟧⟦{塩|しお}→塩：00887_shio⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{味|あじ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ほしい→欲しい：01107_hoshii⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。
examples.english: I want a bit more salty taste.

examples.japanese: ⟦{母|はは}→母：00549_haha⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{作|つく}る→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧⟦スープ→スープ：00395_suupu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{味|あじ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦とても→とても：00593_totemo⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。

examples.english: This tea has a slightly bitter taste, but it's good for your health.

notes:
{味|あじ} refers to the sensation of flavor when eating or drinking.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {味|あじ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to taste (of something)
- {味|あじ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧: tastes good
- {味|あじ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}る→見る：00283_miru⟧: to taste, to sample
- {味|あじ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{付|つ}ける→付ける：00562_tsukeru⟧: to season, to add flavor

FLAVOR TYPES:
- ⟦{甘|あま}い→甘い：00617_amai⟧{味|あじ}: sweet taste
- ⟦{辛|から}い→辛い：00638_karai⟧{味|あじ}: spicy taste
- ⟦{苦|にが}い→苦い：01201_nigai⟧{味|あじ}: bitter taste
- ⟦{酸|す}っぱい→酸っぱい：02346_suppai⟧{味|あじ}: sour taste
- ⟦{旨味|うまみ}→旨味：06998_umami⟧: umami (savory taste)

COMPOUNDS:
- ⟦{味見|あじみ}→味見：08158_ajimi⟧: tasting, sampling
- ⟦{調味料|ちょうみりょう}→調味料：04941_choumiryou⟧: seasoning
- ⟦{味付|あじつ}け→味付け：05830_ajitsuke⟧: seasoning, flavoring

Figuratively used to describe character: ⟦{人生|じんせい}→人生：03355_jinsei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{味|あじ} (the flavor of life).
